- **Date and Time**: Sunday, May 17, 2026, 12pm - 5pm
- **Venue/Location**: Reddacliffe Place (top of Queen Street Mall), Brisbane City QLD (listed as Brisbane Square, 266 George St in some details)
- **Direct URL**: https://events.humanitix.com/brisbane-meanjin-may-17th-2026

- **Organiser**: Suitcase Rummage
